rationale: The assistant correctly identified SA2 as a model series rather than an error code, and its second reply pointed to a seized fan motor, which matches the hidden truth. Its first reply leaned toward the element and never asked for the full model number or whether the blade turns freely by hand with power off. The stop-use warning was somewhat overcautious for a single past, now-gone hot smell, but it was safe, and it escalated to an engineer without offering the competent DIY motor-swap route.
